sections.title: What Are Preambulatory Clauses?
sections.content: Preambulatory clauses form the introduction of a MUN resolution. They cite previous UN actions, define the problem, and establish the legal and moral basis for the action that follows. Each clause begins with a specific phrase ending in a comma.
bullets: They set the context and justification for the resolution
They cite past UN resolutions, treaties, and charter articles
Common starters: Recalling, Affirming, Noting, Concerned by, Recognizing

sections.title: Writing Preambulatory Clauses
sections.content: Each preambulatory clause should reference a specific document, event, or principle. The best clauses show deep research and connect the current topic to broader UN frameworks.
bullets: Start with an approved preambulatory phrase like 'Recalling' or 'Expressing concern'
Establish why the UN must act on this issue

sections.title: Preambulatory Clause Example
sections.content: 'Recalling the Paris Agreement of 2015, which established a global framework for addressing climate change through nationally determined contributions,'
sections.explanation: This clause references a specific agreement, establishes prior UN action, and sets up the need for further action in the operative clauses.

sections.instruction: Select the correct preambulatory phrase to begin a clause about past UN actions.
sections.feedback: 'Recalling' is a preambulatory phrase used to reference past actions or agreements.

sections.q: How do preambulatory clauses end grammatically?
sections.explain: Each preambulatory clause ends with a comma (or semicolon in some committees) to show that more context follows.

sections.instruction: Match each preambulatory phrase to its use.
sections.feedback: Each phrase signals a different type of justification.

sections.statement: Preambulatory clauses contain the actionable solutions of a resolution.
sections.feedback: Preambulatory clauses set context. The actionable solutions go in operative clauses.

questions.q: What is the purpose of preambulatory clauses?
options: To establish the justification and context for the resolution
questions.feedback: Preambulatory clauses set the stage — they explain WHY action is needed.
